title: Why Jensen Huang Came Back to Nvidia: 5 Reasons #Shorts
description:
Nvidia's board accepted Jensen Huang's resignation on 11-12 Nov 2026, said on 17 Nov it did not intend to reinstate him, then voted unanimously on 23 Nov to bring him back. Five likely reasons (our analysis of the reporting): the board says US government input gave it confidence there is no national security risk; the stock had lost almost half its value since its October record; no successor was in place; Semafor reported three directors backed his return; and pressure from investors, a petition and the White House.

Sources (checked 24 Nov 2026):
- NVIDIA 8-K, Huang reinstated (23 Nov 2026): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000090/nov23pressrelease.htm
- AP via PBS NewsHour: https://www.pbs.org/newshour/nation/nvidia-board-unanimously-reinstates-jensen-huang-as-ceo-and-chairman
- Semafor report via Outlook India: https://www.outlookindia.com/international/boardroom-faction-pushes-for-jensen-huangs-return-nvidia-rules-it-out
- Gotrade (NVDA close 23 Nov): https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-24-2026/
- NPR (17 Nov): https://www.wamc.org/2026-11-17/nvidia-board-says-it-does-not-intend-to-reinstate-jensen-huang-as-ceo

Allegations mentioned are reports, not proven facts. Our analysis is labelled as such. News, not financial advice.
This video uses an AI-generated presenter (Google Flow) and animations; facts checked against the sources above. Independent channel, not affiliated with NVIDIA.
